claims.citation: New York Herald, 25 May 1866, p. 9, col. 4
claims.verbatim:
Ship Southern Chief, Higgins, London April 15 (left the
Downs 22d), with mdse, to H D & J U Brookman. April 23,
Richard White, of Boston, a seaman, fell from aloft over-
board and was lost; May 6, William Schuler, of Stettin,
Prussia, fell from the mizzentopsailyard on deck and was
instantly killed; 16th, lat 40 30, lon 57 27, spoke ship Colum-
bia, from New York for Liverpool.
